name: @edupro/api-client
description: Typed client generated from the API's OpenAPI document

scripts.build: test -f src/generated/schema.d.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json || echo 'api-client: schema not generated yet, run pnpm client:generate'
scripts.typecheck: test -f src/generated/schema.d.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit || echo 'api-client: schema not generated yet, skipping typecheck'
